What Is In This HVAC Client Machine?

The HVAC Client Machine is 12 agents, already written, that turn into the work an HVAC company pays for.

You do not build anything. You open ChatGPT, paste the business details, and the agent gives you the deliverable ready to send.

That is the whole job.

Nothing to configure, nothing to install.

For example, if you sell this to "John's HVAC Company" who is running a $89 AC tune-up this month... all you do is put the business name and the offer in. Everything else stays the same.

The depth is what makes the difference: these are not one-line prompts.

These are the seven jobs the 12 agents cover:

  • Missed-call text-back: the reply that goes out in the owner's voice while the tech is on a roof.

  • After-hours triage: the message that separates emergency from routine and gets the callback number.

  • Review engine: the ask, the three-day chase and the public reply to a three-star review, plus the private note to the owner.

  • Repair or replace: the tech notes turned into two priced options and a recommendation the homeowner understands.

  • Season campaigns: tune-up email, SMS, post and call script for the slow weeks before the season.

  • Ads and compliance: five ads, ten search headlines and the policy check that keeps them running.

  • Membership builder: tiers, tech pitch, objections and the page that sells the plan.

System 1

What Problem Does The Missed-Call Agent Solve?

An HVAC company misses calls every single day: the tech is on a roof, the office is closed, the line is busy. The caller dials the next company on Google and the job is gone — and nobody ever tells the owner how much walked away. Two agents cover the first five minutes: one texts back in the owner's voice before the caller cools off, the other triages after hours and pulls the address, the equipment and whether it is heat or cool. The owner wakes up to booked calls instead of a full voicemail box.

System 2

What Problem Does The Season Campaign Solve?

Every year the same panic: the season turns, the phone floods, the shop is short-handed. Then the slow weeks come and nobody planned anything. This agent builds the pre-season campaign while there is still time — email, SMS, social post, office call script and the answers for “my AC is working fine”. Dated, sequenced, ready for the office to start scheduling.

System 3

What Problem Does The Review Engine Solve?

The tech does a good job, the customer is happy, and nobody asks for the review. The five-star customer disappears into silence while one angry three-star sits at the top of the profile forever. This agent asks after the visit, chases twice in 72 hours, replies publicly without getting defensive and writes the private note the owner needs. It is the difference between 12 reviews and 80.

System 4

What Problem Does The Membership Agent Solve?

A tune-up once, then nothing for two years. The membership is the only part of the business that pays in the slow months, and it dies in the pitch — the tech mumbles it at the door and the owner never built the plan. This agent writes the tiers, the 60-second technician pitch, the four objections and the page that sells it, with the price and visit count left as placeholders for the owner to set.

System 5

What Problem Does The Ads Agent Solve?

The owner boosts a post, Meta rejects it for a policy nobody read, and the money stops. Or the account sits empty because writing headlines takes an evening he does not have. This agent returns five ready ads, ten search headlines, the descriptions and a compliance pass that flags what will get the account limited before it is published.

 Frequently Asked Questions

I want this, what exactly am I getting?

Twelve agents inside one ChatGPT project. Each one is written for a job an HVAC company already pays for: missed call, reviews, repair-or-replace, season campaign, membership and ads. You also get the pitch script for the owner and the delivery checklist, so a client sees the same output shown on this page.

Do you offer more in depth help?

Support is by email. If an agent returns something weak, you send the output and we fix the agent. There is no coaching call required to use the product.

Who is this for?

Freelancers and agency owners who want a service to sell to HVAC companies without learning GoHighLevel. You need a ChatGPT account (the free one works) and the nerve to talk to a business owner.

How Is This Delivered?

As a ChatGPT project link. You open it inside your own account, the twelve agents are there, and you duplicate the project for each client. No install, no domain, no CRM.

How is this different than all the other stuff out there?

Most packs are a one-page prompt the AI reads once and forgets. Every agent here is a procedure: what to ask, the shape of the output, what counts as a bad answer and the placeholders the owner still has to fill. That is why the output on this page looks like work and not like a chat.

Is there a guarantee?

Yes. 30 days, money back, no explanation needed. You keep the first three agents either way. One email and it is refunded.
